description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR Since earning our place on the ballot, this campaign has shifted into a new gear entirely. In just the last few days, I held five events in a single day, completed four media interviews, attended a fundraiser, and am now traveling across Eastern Colorado sitting down with ranchers, farmers, and families who love this state and are ready for real leadership. The fire out here is something you have to see to believe. With that momentum comes opposition, and I welcome
title: TEAM VICTOR WEEKLY TEAM UPDATE - APRIL 20, 2026
